_comment: Ratchet, not a cap you can raise. A skill ABSENT from `grandfathered` must have a
body at or under `limitBytes`. A skill LISTED here must stay at or under its recorded
size: it may shrink, never grow. When it reaches limitBytes, delete its entry.
Entries are never added - a new skill over budget is a build failure, not a new row.
Body excludes YAML frontmatter, measured exactly as validate-skills.yml measures it.
Over budget? Move detail into references/ - those load on demand and are not counted.
